bills.title: Digital ID (Transitional and Consequential Provisions) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted in favour of government amendments on [sheet UP109](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fs1404_amend_9f9593f9-b0e2-4c2b-85ab-3caf7f3673cb%22;rec=0), which means they will now be incorporated into the bill. The amendments related to law enforcement reporting, deactivation, privacy, testing, phasing-in, destruction of information and a fees review. ### What do these amendments do? The Government provided a [supplementary explanatory memorandum](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fems%2Fs1404_ems_bea16aaa-9e69-4e6d-9121-ae585f9f35e1%22;rec=0) to explain what these amendments do.
